Class ScenarioGisExporter

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioGisExporter
public class ScenarioGisExporter extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller for GIS Multi-Format Data and Cryptographic Provenance Manifest Exports.

Extracted from ScenarioSetupPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Exports scenario configurations, demographic layers, and cultural tensors to standardized GIS formats (GeoJSON FeatureCollection, GeoTIFF multi-band metadata, NetCDF-4 spatiotemporal cubes) and generates SHA-256 provenance manifests ensuring epistemic falsification and scientific reproducibility.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
